description: This file is a shell script used for testing various git diff and related commands, including setup, checking file differences, patch applications, conflict resolutions, and submodule handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success outcome with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Asserts that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails (non-zero exit code).

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes in the repository, possibly with options.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
